findings.title: Parameters after &signature= are not covered by the origin signature but are reported as verified
tx preview shows only the opaque XDR and never decodes its operations
origin_domain fetch reaches any multi-label host, including names that resolve to private or metadata addresses
network_passphrase is accepted and shown without any check against the wallet network
Strict-validation claim does not match behaviour for unknown and network parameters
asset_issuer accepted without asset_code, shown in preview as if it qualifies an asset
memo values are not checked against memo_type (MEMO_ID, MEMO_TEXT length, MEMO_HASH size)
Query decoder turns '+' into a space, breaking unencoded base64 signature and xdr values
Amount validator accepts '.' and other non-numeric forms and returns the untrimmed string
findings.evidence: src/parse.rs:722 `// Allow digits, exactly one optional '.', no sign.`

findings.title: Federation destinations containing '*' bypass all validation
Unknown query parameters are silently dropped although the parser claims to reject unvalidated input

failing_checks.title: Outbound requests and file paths
failing_checks.reason: The requester controls origin_domain, which is passed to fetch_stellar_toml(domain) after only FQDN syntax validation (parse.rs:336-339 validate_origin_domain_syntax). Any multi-label name that resolves to a private, loopback or metadata address is fetched, so the agent can be used as an SSRF probe.

failing_checks.title: Stated purpose versus behaviour
failing_checks.reason: The README and crate doc claim strict validation and reject-never-ignore. The code removes known keys and returns without checking the rest, so unknown parameters pass silently. network_passphrase is also passed through with no check (parse.rs:418), and it is shown in the preview as if it were check

failing_checks.title: Core function works
failing_checks.reason: The core path fails for standard base64 values. '+' is turned into a space before base64 decode, so a standard-base64 xdr or signature containing '+' is rejected or verified wrongly. Other SDK and type uses look correct: TransactionEnvelope::from_xdr with Limits, to_xdr_base64, stellar_strkey, ed255
